keyFindings.description: true_unset/call_inputs (154-170) model an unset input as ''. A workflow_call that omits an input gets its declared default, and on the workflow's own pull_request run the input is null, which GitHub coerces to 0 against a numeric-looking literal. Reproduced with the test file's fixture/call_modes: inputs.mode == '' with default "build" -> exit 0; inputs.mode != 'attest' with default "attest" -> exit 0; inputs.mode != '0' -> exit 0. Each turns the build off on every call or every pull request while the required lint check passes. Fix: admit only inputs.<name> == '' on a type: string input whose default is absent or "" (drop the != admission, which worker-image.yaml does not use), add refusal cases, correct the 'compares as ''' wording.

554: a whole-run rerun 're-executes legion_build, which releases that tag again' - legion_build decides the version; publish releases it and worker_image_release moves the tag. 455: the version tag goes on the digest worker_image pushed, not on whatever the mutable sha- tag names.

119-123: 'a dropped pending main run never leaves a commit with no image to pin' does not hold for release.yaml's attest-only call, which shares worker-image-<sha>: a pending attest call replaced by a further same-sha run leaves the released digest unattested (fails closed at verify). Say so.
